claim_one_line: THE KERNEL AT THE PUNCTURE (sealed a1bd642a6; PROVED -- every cell holds as sealed): for every Higgs S in End(C^2) = span(1, i, j, k) at the fibre's puncture the residue coupling has the theta triplet R as a two-sided null vector (to 5e-31 at 6 tau x 4 random S, by contour residues at 30 digits), since S = 1 gives B1642's antisymmetric coupling with null vector R and S in M gives B1644's, which kills R by Jacobi; so with both quark sectors on one fibre the first generation is massless and unmixed at leading order -- the mixing matrix is 1 (+) U(2) (|V_ud| = 1, V_us = V_ub = V_cd = V_td = 0 to 3e-16; m1/m3 below 1e-16 in both sectors), m_u = m_d = theta12 = theta13 = J = 0 -- while the 2-3 sector is free (the map to m_c/m_t, m_s/m_b, |V_cb| has full rank 3); a non-isotropic control breaks both (m1/m3 0.060, V_us 0.028), so the zeros are Jacobi's. On this route at leading order: five zeros fixed, five numbers free; the Cabibbo angle (0.227, context) must come entirely from what lifts R.  [Scoped by frame at S124 (2026-10-14): the zero holds in Lambda's frame, the fibre at one tau, where a cubic invariant of two rho_Q zero modes forces the Higgs's internal factor to be even (the SM seat's reading after W71). In the surface frame tau integrates out and the coupling is a fixed bilinear form of full rank, so the zero does not survive (the SM seat's W72). In the audit lane's E8 frame the even S is a flavon, so the physical Yukawa needs P-108.] 0 of 19.
